note: Subject layer of the Goblin visual-direction study (bead pulp_wars-3tq.8). Exploration only.

subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER: Subject: Goblin, a chunky cute scrappy little goblin with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small hunched body leaning forward, the head and ears filling the whole width of the image: saturated yellow-olive green skin shaded darker olive, two long pointed ears sticking straight out sideways, a long pointy nose, big cream eyes with black pupils and a wide jagged toothy grin, a near-black dark brown leather bandana tied over the top of the head with two short knot tails, a near-black dark brown patched leather tunic with two lighter brown stitched hide patches covering the chest, belly and legs down to the knees, dirty cream bandage wraps round both forearms, one small rusted iron shoulder plate painted with hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes, a charcoal grey belt, an oversized jagged light grey iron dagger held up in the right hand, bare olive green hands and big bare olive green feet; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a sneaky little stabber, not a soldier with a shield.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN: Subject: Bomb Chucker, a chunky cute little goblin bomb thrower with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small hunched body, the head and ears filling the whole width of the image: saturated yellow-olive green skin shaded darker olive, long pointed ears sticking out sideways, a big excited grin, a dented rusted iron pot helmet with big round dark iron goggles pushed up on its front, a near-black dark brown patched leather tunic with one lighter brown stitched hide patch covering the chest, belly and legs down to the knees, the right arm raised high holding one big round black bomb above the head with one band of hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes round its middle, a short cream fuse and a small red-orange spark, a bulging dark brown leather satchel of round black bombs on the left hip, dirty cream bandage wraps round the forearms, bare olive green feet; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a bomb thrower, not an archer.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT: Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute rickety home-made goblin rocket cart, clearly bigger than a soldier, filling the whole width of the image: one huge fat stubby home-made rocket built from a dented rusty iron barrel of mismatched bolted scrap plates, with one wide band of hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes round it, a crooked pointed dull grey tin cone cap, a long thin pale stick sticking out behind its tail and a long curly cream fuse with a small red-orange spark at its end; the rocket is tilted up at forty-five degrees, points forward and is tied down with loops of pale cream rope onto a small crooked cart of weathered dark brown planks on two mismatched rusty iron wheels, one big and one small; a tiny goblin with saturated yellow-olive green skin, long pointed ears and a near-black dark brown leather tunic and cap crouches on the ground behind the cart covering its ears; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a home-made scrap rocket on a junk cart, not a modern missile and not a catapult.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT/FIREWORKS: Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute rickety goblin fireworks cart, clearly bigger than a soldier but narrow and compact: a small crooked hand cart of weathered brown planks on two wobbly wooden wheels, loaded with a tight bundle of five home-made fireworks rockets of different sizes standing up on thin wooden sticks and leaning forward, tied together with pale rope: fat paper tubes in grubby red, orange, yellow, one blue and one green, each with a pointed cream paper cone on top and a short curly fuse, one fuse lit with a small red-orange spark; a tiny goblin with deep green skin, long pointed ears and an orange-brown leather loincloth and cap stands close behind the cart holding a burning match; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a cart of fireworks about to go off, not a missile and not a catapult.
